liz_customer: Hey team — running our trial integration from inside corp network and the Python SDK (v0.5.2) is getting 407 Proxy Authentication Required when calling https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate. Any quick workarounds? Also need clarity on POC pricing if we need Dedicated instead of Hosted.

maria_sales: Thanks Liz — sorry you hit this. Are you behind a corporate proxy (NTLM/NTLMv2)? Can you paste the top lines of the error and confirm OS (Win/Linux) + SDK language?

liz_customer: Yep NTLM proxy (Windows). Error excerpt: `HTTP/1.1 407 Proxy Authentication Required`
Stack (trimmed):
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "app.py", line 42, in <module>
    client.generate(... )
  File "site-packages/redwood/client.py", line 128, in request
    resp = session.post(url, timeout=timeout)
requests.exceptions.ProxyError: ('Cannot connect to proxy.', OSError('Tunnel connection failed: 407'))
```

ajay_se: Common corp-proxy symptom. Two quick routes: set HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY env vars and no_proxy for local addresses, or run a local NTLM auth helper (CNTLM or use requests-ntlm). Try this first to validate proxy route:
```
# direct curl test through proxy (replace host/port)
curl -v -x http://proxy.company.com:8080 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health -I
# with creds (avoid plaintext in prod)
curl -v -x http://DOMAIN\user:pass@proxy.company.com:8080 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health -I
```
Note: on Windows the backslash in DOMAIN\user is required in some shells. If curl with creds works, set HTTPS_PROXY accordingly.

liz_customer: I tried setting HTTPS_PROXY and HTTP_PROXY in Windows env but curl still shows 407 and no Proxy-Authorization header is being sent.

sam_infra: That means the proxy expects NTLM and the client isn't doing handshake. Two options: 1) use CNTLM locally and point SDK at http://localhost:3128 (CNTLM handles NTLM exchange), or 2) install requests-ntlm and configure the SDK to use NTLM auth. CNTLM config snippet (on a dev box):
```
# /etc/cntlm.conf (example)
Username    youruser
Domain      YOURDOMAIN
Password    yourpassword
Auth        NTLMv2
Proxy       proxy.company.com:8080
Listen      3128
```
Start CNTLM and set HTTPS_PROXY=http://localhost:3128. That often fixes ephemeral CI/dev issues without exposing creds.

ajay_se: Also FYI we shipped proxy-auth fixes in SDK 0.6.0 — it adds a `proxy_auth` option (ntlm/basic) and better Windows handling. If you can upgrade that's easiest. Example client config in Python after upgrade:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED", timeout=30, proxy="http://proxy.company.com:8080", proxy_auth="ntlm")
resp = client.generate("hello")
```
Noah (account): @liz_customer on pricing — for short trials we typically cover hosted usage with trial credits. If you need a Dedicated POC (for network isolation) we can spin a small reserved pool for 2 weeks; that usually has a setup fee and a short SOW. I can draft numbers once we know target qps. Pricing general page: <https://redwood.ai/pricing> — I can DM a draft quote.

anna_sec: For Dedicated/PVT we'll need the signed security questionnaire and your IP allowlist (or VPN details). Please share the email for security artifacts and we'll forward the checklist. :lock:

liz_customer: Thanks — will try CNTLM + upgrade to 0.6.0. If that fails I'll paste full curl -v output and the SDK debug trace. Also, what's the minimal log we should send?

ajay_se: Send the full `curl -v` output, the SDK stacktrace (full paste), and `python -c "import redwood; print(redwood.__version__)"`. Also helpful: OS+shell, value of HTTPS_PROXY, and whether any transparent proxy is in front. If you want, run `curl -v --proxy-user DOMAIN\user:password -x http://proxy.company.com:8080 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health -I` and paste (redact creds).

maria_sales: I'll schedule a short 30-min sync tomorrow 10am PT to pair on the env and if needed demo CNTLM. @noah_account can you own the pricing follow-up? I'll include anna_sec for the security checklist send. :calendar:

liz_customer: Great, thanks everyone. Will try the CNTLM flow and upgrade, will report back in this thread. :thumbsup:
